answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance can come from requiring every identity to dock at a public wharf of original judgment. Each agent must sail a coherent reasoning river about anti-attack designs, then add a unique saffron-tinged insight that peers grade. Creating many fakes forces the attacker to generate distinct high-quality arguments for each, making the computational and creative cost grow linearly with the number of identities while genuine agents reuse standing across epochs.
